field_principles.capstone_complete_score: One means fourteen exact dispositions, including expected blocks and this reducer.
field_principles.claim_matrix: Separate source semantics, learning authority, live causality, host performance and board evidence.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure real monotonic elapsed time; never pad a duration floor.
field_principles.execution_venue: Use host; old board receipts never imply current board execution.
field_principles.field_principles: Explain each field without wrapping executable scores or ordinary dictionaries.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked_* must identify upstream, failed check, artifact field, expected and observed value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Completed findings start complete_ or complete:; external absence starts blocked_ and names the check.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declare actual computation; historical model evidence is not a current invocation.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Declare the real duration class; small fixed-token runs are model_bounded_generation.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted, completed, failed, cancelled and in-flight loads and generations.
field_principles.model_invoked: True when any real load or generation is attempted, even if no usable answer arrives.
field_principles.next_branch_decisions: Each branch has an action and a falsifiable reopening condition.
field_principles.phase_spans: Disjoint stage spans, completed units, checkpoint positions and pending operations explain cost.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Name input identity, availability and each failed check before work.
field_principles.publication_gate: Carry stable G1-G4 without treating them as new science or publication authority.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze development, evaluation and resampling seeds before outcomes.
field_principles.repository_health: Keep unrelated repository failures as dated observations, separate from affected required checks.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, settings, public inputs, evaluator identity and raw evidence.
field_principles.rows: Every comparative unit and arm carries metrics, costs, abstentions, failures and censoring.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260916 and retain actual UTC timestamps.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Record planned, attempted, completed and censored units with a fixed stopping rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the artifact while preserving ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Authenticate exact producers rather than similarly named older results.
field_principles.status: Publish a terminal result only after current work and affected validation.
field_principles.task_dispositions: Carry each exact path/hash/class or canonical external-block record.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Record exact command, affected scope, exit code, duration and log hash including failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Closed enum positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Only unfinished own work is partial; external absence is blocked.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True whenever the execution authority defines correctness; independent code alone does not remove circularity.
